about: Forget about idyllic ponds or beautiful coral reefs. Dynamite Fishing – World Games will ship you to the best fishing spots all over the globe, including an awesome jungle adventure! Choose your favorite characters and boats, explore the most daring scenarios and catch as many fish as you can.
WARNING! All fish in this game are trained stunt fish! Do not attempt to re-create or perform the same or similar stunts at home…your goldfish will not enjoy it!
✔ More than 10 boats with epic equipment to choose from
✔ Loads of outfits and accessories for 5 crazy characters
✔ An arsenal of exceptional special weapons to use
✔ Unique super powers for each character
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
